entities.summary: Furkan Korkmaz is a Turkish professional basketball player for Tofaş of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). He was born and raised in Istanbul, and was selected 26th in the 2016 NBA draft by the Philadelphia 76ers. Korkmaz is 6 ft 7 in (2.01 m) tall and plays the shooting guard and small forward positions.
